name: RSAWIT
recent: RSAWIT 近期宣布以 RM18.39 million 出售位于 Sarawak 的约 613 公顷土地，并披露与关联方 Borneo Edible Oils 的棕仁销售实际交易额超出股东授权估算逾 10%。此外，董事经理 Datuk Tiong Chiong Ie 在 10 月多次申报间接增持股份。
notable: 以 RM18,390,000 现金出售位于 Sungai Bok, Bakong, Baram 的约 613 公顷土地给 Lembaga Amanah Kebajikan Masjid Negeri Sarawak。
与 Borneo Edible Oils 的棕仁销售实际交易额超出股东授权估算逾 10%。
董事经理 Datuk Tiong Chiong Ie 在 10 月多次申报间接增持公司股份。
risks: 关联方交易实际金额超出股东授权估算逾 10%，需关注后续合规披露。
新闻标题提及 Rimbunan Sawit 因封锁事件遭受 RM10 million 损失。

news.title: Rimbunan Sawit takes RM10mil hit from blockade

recent_en: RSAWIT recently announced the disposal of approximately 613 hectares of land in Sarawak for RM18.39 million, and disclosed that actual palm kernel sales to related party Borneo Edible Oils exceeded the shareholder mandate estimate by more than 10%. In addition, Managing Director Datuk Tiong Chiong Ie reported multiple indirect acquisitions of shares in October.
notable_en: Disposed approximately 613 hectares of land at Sungai Bok, Bakong, Baram to Lembaga Amanah Kebajikan Masjid Negeri Sarawak for RM18,390,000 cash.
Actual palm kernel sales to Borneo Edible Oils exceeded the shareholder mandate estimate by more than 10%.
Managing Director Datuk Tiong Chiong Ie reported multiple indirect acquisitions of shares in October.
risks_en: Actual related party transaction value exceeded the shareholder mandate estimate by more than 10%, requiring attention to subsequent compliance disclosure.
News headline mentions Rimbunan Sawit took a RM10 million hit from a blockade.
